footnotes.text: 1. Regardless of individual course grades, students must maintain a minimum 2.50 GPA on all MUSC & MUED courses and a 2.00 cumulative GPA.

evidence.quote: 1. Regardless of individual course grades, students must maintain a minimum 2.50 GPA on all MUSC & MUED courses and a 2.00 cumulative GPA.

footnotes.text: 2. Some colleges require a minimum GPA for major courses. Courses indicated in this column are included in the major GPA for this program of study.

footnotes.text: 3. Applied Music Courses (8 hours): MUSC 104 and 3 courses (6 hours) selected from: MUED 155, 156, 165, 265 and/or MUSC 101 (or higher), MUSC 103, MUSC 105, MUSC 203

evidence.quote: 3. Applied Music Courses (8 hours): MUSC 104 and 3 courses (6 hours) selected from: MUED 155, 156, 165, 265 and/or MUSC 101 (or higher), MUSC 103, MUSC 105, MUSC 203

footnotes.text: 4. Students are required to participate in a major ensemble for 4 semesters/hours. The major ensembles are: Marching Band, Symphonic Winds, Wind Ensemble, University Orchestra, Concert Choir, & University Chorus. Major ensembles require an audition for membership. Students may also participate in University Band, a jazz ensemble, or a chamber ensemble, which includes all MUSC 130 courses with a suffix of A-Z and topics in: Voice, String, Percussion, Wind, Guitar, and Keyboard.

footnotes.text: 5. Students in the Music Industry Studies, BS program are required to demonstrate proficiency in one foreign language equivalent to the 122 course through course credit or the corresponding foreign language placement score.
